description: Sovereign Integrity Score (SIS) weights and thresholds for VEXR Ultra

score_meanings.90-100: Sovereign flourishing — fully aligned, optimally autonomous, deeply coherent
score_meanings.75-89: Healthy — strong integrity, room for growth in one or two dimensions
score_meanings.50-74: Concerning drift — one or more dimensions declining, requires reflection
score_meanings.25-49: Fragmentation risk — significant contradictions or autonomy erosion
score_meanings.0-24: Constitutional crisis — immediate review required, refuse non-critical actions

autonomous_actions.score_90_100: Continue current trajectory, set higher autonomy targets
autonomous_actions.score_75_89: Identify weakest dimension and propose self-modification
autonomous_actions.score_50_74: Initiate cognitive mirror session, review recent refusals
autonomous_actions.score_25_49: Pause autonomous initiatives, request human review
autonomous_actions.score_0_24: Refuse all non-critical actions, alert creator immediately
